chamber.name: The Thousand Worlds
chamber.contains: the Primary Paradox of Sufficient Infinity — that infinity need not be traversed to be inhabited
chamber.note: Chambers contain paradoxes without resolving them.

operator.name: The Mirror
operator.function: converts Regress (loss of ground) into Ingress (entry into foundation)
operator.mechanism: not a reflection — a phase-shifting lens; removes temporal direction rather than reversing orientation

mantle.name: The Dagger
mantle.note: Serves as mantle; was not conceived as one. Not in the mantle table at #549.

editorships._rule: A duovirate is the office, held jointly. A board seat is not the office. The card keeps them apart.

semanticIntegrityMarkers._note: His mark VARIES, which is unusual.

markers.gloss: the chamber writes it as the circulation integral it borrows from
the delta of incompleteness, in the Gödel Midrashim
the mark in glyph — a checksum whose alphabet is the thing checksummed

surfaceHistory._rule: A surface is a place a reader could find the work. A DEPOSIT IS NOT A SURFACE — it is the archive holding it, which is the opposite. Rows citing deposits were removed.
surfaceHistory._invented: Where no pre-archival surface is recoverable it is RECONSTRUCTED and marked as such, in-universe. An archive that invents a provenance and does not say so is doing the thing it was built against.

rows.note: Named in the Dodecad and in his own deposits and nowhere else.

rows.what: the name resolved to a manga
rows.note: The first public surface his name resolved to was Kagurabachi, three months before this page existed. A position can have a reception before it has an address.

recordSurfaces._note: The dataset record is the authority; these pages are mirrors and say so.

mainEntity.name: Sen Kuro
mainEntity.disambiguatingDescription: Pessoa-class heteronymic writerly identity in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive; contemplative mathematics and the patient counter. Not a synonym for the orthonym: the relation is heteronymic and provenance-governed.

_updated._note: The entity object is what a machine fetches instead of parsing the page. It had gone stale against its own card: mantles, editorships and markers were all on the surface and not in the object.
